title: 我毋是鮭魚 Guá M̄-sī Kue-hî
mood: deadpan, sheepish and bouncy, a joke the singer has finally stopped living inside
subject: a man who changed his legal name to 'Lim Salmon' in 2021 for a free sushi-restaurant feast and has lived with it on every bank queue screen and job interview since, back at the household registration office for his third and, by law, last name change, while the clerk reminds him this one is final
caption: Taiwanese Hokkien amapiano in the South African private-school piano style. A deep amapiano log drum bass sliding and gliding between notes; a soft shaker and open hi-hat on a laid-back swung groove; warm Rhodes electric piano chords with jazzy extensions; an airy synth pad; dry hand claps on the offbeats. Spacious, warm late-night mix with the log drum sitting under everything. A relaxed male baritone singing conversationally and straight-faced, with a light group-vocal answer on the chorus. 113 BPM, F minor. Deadpan, sheepish and bouncy. No trap hi-hats, no autotune, no EDM build or drop, no rap verse, no Afrobeats guitar, no pop ballad chorus.
lyrics:
[Verse]
彼年春天 壽司店貼一張紙
名內底有鮭魚 規桌免錢食
我騎去戶政事務所 抽著三號
身分證面頂 我變做林鮭魚

[Pre-Chorus]
食甲第九盤 頭家目睭紅紅
朋友攏咧笑 講我上勇

[Chorus]
我毋是鮭魚 我毋是鮭魚
銀行叫號 規間攏越頭
我毋是鮭魚 我叫林志明
小姐拜託 共我改轉來

[Verse]
五冬過去 寄來的批 攏寫鮭魚
面試的經理 看一下 煞笑出聲
健保卡 駕照 攏著閣換
連公司的同事 嘛叫我鮭魚仔

[Pre-Chorus]
今仔日 我閣坐佇戶政事務所
抽著的號碼 閣是三號

[Chorus]
我毋是鮭魚 我毋是鮭魚
窗口小姐 嘛忍袂牢咧笑
我毋是鮭魚 我叫林志明
這擺 我袂閣亂來

[Verse]
小姐講 改名規世人 干焦三擺
頭一擺 是算命仙叫你改
第二擺 是為著一盤壽司
這擺若改 就無後擺矣

[Bridge]
我提起筆 手咧顫
林志明三字 寫甲足端正
伊共印仔 頓落去

[Chorus]
我毋是鮭魚 我毋是鮭魚
規間戶政 攏咧拍噗仔
我毋是鮭魚 我叫林志明
出門 我去食一碗滷肉飯

[Outro]
壽司店 閣貼一張紙矣
